changelog:
Initial release of cron-helper.

- Schedule and manage recurring tasks using natural language (e.g. "every 2 hours", "daily at 9am").
- List, pause, resume, and delete scheduled tasks.
- Track execution history and failures for each task.
- Supports timezone-aware scheduling.
- Avoids complex cron syntax; easy automation for periodic work.
summary: Configure, diagnose, and fix OpenClaw cron jobs. Activate when user mentions: cron, scheduled tasks, periodic jobs, timing issues, heartbeat vs cron, or any...
